title: S.A.M Spell
description: Defines a custom spell. S.A.M's spell loader registers it into its runtime spell registry at a reserved id (>=2000) so it can be referenced by name ('namespace:spell'). The spell casts like the vanilla spell its 'payload' names, and shows in the spell list with its name and icon. Nothing grants it by itself: add its id to a class's or race's starting_spells, call sam_grant_spell, or give your mod a spellbook item whose spellbook_spell is this spell. Fields that are saved but not used yet: speed, and damage_min (it only decides whether the tooltip shows a damage tag; damage_max sets the damage).

$schema.description: Optional. URL of this JSON Schema, so editors give autocomplete + validation as you type. Ignored by S.A.M itself.

id.description: Unique spell id in 'namespace:spell' form (e.g. 'darkmage:shadow_bolt'). S.A.M assigns the runtime numeric spell id (>=2000) automatically.

name.description: Display name of the spell (e.g. 'Shadow Bolt').

description.description: Short flavor/description text shown for the spell.

mana_cost.description: Mana required to cast the spell.

difficulty.description: Needed to LEARN this spell from a book or tome: your skill in the spell's school (see school) plus your INT must reach this number. It also sets the spell's level, difficulty divided by 20, shown as tier I to VI (0 to 19 is I, 20 to 39 is II, and so on up to 100 or more for VI). 0 (default) means any character can learn it, even a low-INT melee class. Raise it to gate the spell behind magic skill like a vanilla spellbook.

school.description: (new in 3.7.0) Which school of magic the spell belongs to: sorcery (the default, and what every custom spell was before this field existed), mysticism or thaumaturgy. It decides which skill the learn difficulty is checked against (a spell with difficulty 0 checks none) and which skill casting the spell trains, which stats add to its power (Sorcery: INT, Mysticism: INT and CHR, Thaumaturgy: INT and CON), which robes help it, and the school icon in its tooltip.

learn_requirements.description: (new in 3.7.0) Extra things a character needs to LEARN this spell from a book or tome, on top of difficulty. Each must be met or the book is not read and the player is told the first thing they lack. stats: the least STR, DEX, CON, INT, PER or CHR needed (gear and effects count). skills: the least level in a skill, by its PRO_ name, for example PRO_LEADERSHIP: 20. Only checked when a book or tome is read: a spell a class, a race or sam_grant_spell hands over is always learned.

projectile_type.description: How the spell is delivered. 'missile' = a single bolt (Barony PROPULSION_MISSILE / spell_element_missile root). 'missile_trio' = a 3-way spread (PROPULSION_MISSILE_TRIO / spell_element_trio). 'none' only marks the tooltip as a self spell: the spell still fires its bolt, so a spell that must not shoot needs a script on player.on_spell_cast that returns false.

payload.description: The spell's effect payload — maps 1:1 to a real Barony spell element (e.g. 'fire' -> spell_element_fireball, 'force' -> spell_element_forcebolt, 'charm_monster' -> spell_element_charm, 'magic_missile' -> spell_element_magicmissile). Determines the bolt's on-hit behavior.

damage_min.description: Not used by the bolt: damage_max sets the damage. Setting either number only adds a damage tag to the tooltip.

damage_max.description: Damage the bolt deals (the payload's damage is set to this). Leave it out to keep the payload's own damage.

range.description: How long the bolt lives, in game ticks (50 per second). The engine default is 75, roughly a corridor's length. This is a lifetime, not a distance in tiles: 6 here is a bolt that vanishes at the caster's fingertips. Omit it to keep the default.

speed.description: Not used yet: the bolt keeps the payload's speed.

on_hit_effect.description: Optional. Status effect applied to whatever the bolt hits: a built-in name such as 'EFF_POISONED', or one of your own custom effects by its exact id ('namespace:effect', lowercase, e.g. 'mymod:plague'). A name that matches nothing is ignored, with one warning line in sam_log.txt. For payloads that apply a status of their own (slow, confuse, sleep and similar) it applies only when that status lands too. It applies whenever the bolt reports a hit: never for ghost_bolt or dig, for steal_weapon only when a weapon is actually taken, and for charm_monster only when the charm or pacify lands.

on_hit_duration.description: Optional. Duration in game ticks (50/sec) of on_hit_effect. 0 or left out uses the custom effect's own duration_ticks, otherwise 250 ticks (5 seconds).

on_hit_chance.description: Optional. Percent chance (0-100) that on_hit_effect triggers on a hit. 0 or left out means every hit.

icon.description: Optional. Path to a PNG spell icon, written from the folder that holds mod.json (not from the spells folder): e.g. 'spells/shadow_bolt.png', with no leading slash, no '..' and no 'mods/<folder>/' in front. It is drawn on the hotbar, in the spell list, in the tooltip and in the new-spell popup. If the file is not found, or the path is wrong, the generic spell orb is used and sam_log.txt names the path it looked for. Restart the game after changing the file.

starting_spell.description: Optional. Hint that this spell is intended as a class starting spell. Actual granting is driven by a class's 'starting_spells' array (which may list this spell's 'namespace:spell' id).

examples.name: Shadow Bolt
examples.description: A bolt of condensed shadow that saps the life from its target.
